versions.changelog:
uberfix-maintenance 1.0.0

- Initial release of the UberFix Maintenance skill.
- Enables creating and managing maintenance requests in UberFix using approved tools.
- Supports actions to open, check, inspect, add notes to, cancel requests, and request quotations.
- Provides detailed usage guidelines and strict security/authorization instructions.
- Requires all operations to use live, authorized tool responses; no direct credential handling or data invention.
